dataset_weighting: Equal weight across 3 datasets; 42 seeds equally within dataset
warning: Averaging 42 seeds is descriptive split robustness, NOT independent external validation; FULL_DATA excluded from winner ranking.

metrics_definition.balanced_accuracy: mean of recall over true classes in the evaluation set
metrics_definition.macro_f1: mean of per-class F1 over union of true and predicted labels
metrics_definition.conflict_case_rate: matches involve two or more distinct predicted class labels
metrics_definition.true_in_candidate_rate: true class appears in the matched rule decisions
